summary: Elon Musk signals he would walk away from building Tesla's robot army if he cannot secure ~25% voting control, warning activist investors (via ISS/Glass Lewis) could force him out despite doing everything right, which would threaten the company's core Optimus/robotics mission.
quote: I'm not going to build a robot army if I can be easily kicked out by activist investors.

summary: Elon Musk argues Grokipedia is a fundamentally superior product to Wikipedia — more accurate, comprehensive, neutral, and soon to include video — and will naturally win because users will recognize and share the better source.
quote: I have complete confidence that Grokkoopedia is going to succeed because Wikipedia is actually not a very good product... It's not going to be a little bit better than Wikipedia. It's going to be 100 times better than Wikipedia.

summary: Elon Musk describes X's trajectory as transformative: Grok will semantically index 100M posts/day to personalize feeds and enable plain-language search, making X the best source of truth on the planet and dramatically increasing its platform value.
quote: Grok is going to... read through 100 million things and show you the things that it thinks out of 100 million posts per day, what are the most interesting posts to you... we want X to be the best source of truth on the planet by far.
